# `scene.duplicate`: Duplicate

Duplicates an object as an independent copy or as an instance sharing its mesh.

- Category: scene
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(depth + log n)
- Flags: undoable, creates_objects
- Also known as: copy, clone, instance, linked duplicate, shift d, alt d

Creates a sibling with the same transform (plus `offset`), tags and metadata. `copy` gets its own mesh (free until edited); `instance` shares the mesh, so edits apply to all instances and exports can reuse it. Children are not duplicated.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `DuplicateMode` | `"copy"` | `copy` (independent mesh, default) or `instance` (shares the mesh). |
| `name` | `string \| null` | `null` | Name of the duplicate; a free variant of the source name when omitted. |
| `offset` | `[Length, Length, Length]` | `[0.0,0.0,0.0]` | Added to the duplicate's position. |
| `target` | `string` | required | Object to duplicate (name, path or id). |

## Examples

```json
{"mode":"instance","offset":[1,0,0],"target":"crate"}
```

Result: `duplicated crate (o:1) as crate_1 (o:5), instance`
